description: Profile zagłuszeniowe jammerów GNSS is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Blue Dot Solutions sp z o.o.. Jamming profiles of selected, popular devices jamming GPS/GNSS signals ("jamming"). Measurements obtained in laboratory conditions determining the characteristics of each device in the frequency spectrum ranging from 1000 to 1800 MHz, using commercially available equipment. Coverage: Blue Dot Solutions sp z o.o.. The portal shows the English title as "GNSS jammer jamming profiles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Blue Dot Solutions sp z o.o.. Its keywords include gps, GNSS. The listing shows 5 download or service links in XLSX, ZIP. The listing shows 2024-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
